//: Cadence philosophy: this is a buy-and-hold portfolio. We refresh, classify, and alert once per weekday at market close (21:00 UTC ≈ 17:00 ET, after US close). Snapshot follows at 21:30 UTC after quotes are warm. Filings pull overnight (05:30 UTC). Weekly review is the deep cadence (Sunday 13:00 UTC). Daily review is ON-DEMAND only — a button on the dashboard, not a cron — because a static portfolio produces near-identical EOD reviews day after day. Email digests only fire for material events (see lib/preferences silentUnlessMaterial).
